heroHeadline: World War II: The Deadliest Conflict in Human History
heroSubtitle: Eighty-one years on — Lost 52 Project locates USS Bonefish, Drexler, and William D. Porter; 98 unseen 1941 Paris roundup photos exhibited for the first time; fewer than 100,000 American WWII veterans remain
footerNote: Data sourced from NARA, Imperial War Museum, Yad Vashem, US Holocaust Memorial Museum, Russian State Military Archive, and national archives. Casualty figures are estimates; exact totals remain contested.
